senses.gloss: रेचक (I) a. (f. चिका) 1. Emptying; 2. purgative; 3. emptying the lungs, emitting the breath.
रेचक (II) m. 1. The act of breathing out, exhalation, especially through one of the nostrils, (op. to पूरक ‘inhalation’); (also read रेच in this sense); 2. a syringe; 3. nitre, salt-petre.
रेचक (III) n. A purge, a cathartic.
रेचक (I) a. (f. चिका) 1. Emptying; 2. purgative; 3. emptying the lungs, emitting the breath.
रेचन n. 1. The act of emptying or lessening; 2. emitting breath; 3. evacuation.
रेचना f. 1. The act of emptying or lessening; 2. emitting breath; 3. evacuation.
